name: Dr. Erik Pleitez
bio: Dr. Erik Pleitez is a dedicated general and restorative dentist who co-founded Pleitez Dental Corp alongside Dr. Martha Pleitez. Known by patients for his skillful hands, calm chairside manner, and thorough diagnostic approach, Dr. Erik has earned a reputation for providing honest, ethical dental care. From complex implant evaluations to everyday family dentistry, he is committed to helping every patient achieve a healthy, confident smile.
